aboutme.title: About me
aboutme.texto_about_me:
I am passionate about software development and enjoy turning ideas into useful web and mobile applications. I am currently a Junior Full Stack developer, technologist, and Software Engineering student. I am constantly learning, exploring new technologies, and growing with every project I take on.

 I consider myself curious, adaptable, and proactive, qualities that have allowed me to easily integrate into teams, take on new challenges, and propose creative solutions that bring real value to users. Beyond coding, I am motivated by the idea that every line I write can help solve problems and improve the lives of those who use the applications.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Here you will find all my featured projects. Explore each one to learn more about my technical skills and experience.
projects.info-project1: My personal web portfolio, here you will be able to explore some of my featured projects, you will also learn about my technical skills and discover a little more about my background and training.
projects.info-project2: Website that simplifies the recruitment of professional services by allowing clients to browse categories, review worker profiles and contact them directly. Workers can register their profile, receive and respond to specific requests, all with an intuitive design and efficient functionalities.
projects.info-project3: Desktop application for Multirepuestos Boyacá: a sales system designed to optimize inventory control, manage suppliers and customers, and generate reports. It guarantees efficiency and security in the spare parts company.
projects.info-project4: Web platform offering a wide section of classic and fun games Designed to provide instant entertainment and fun for all users.
projects.info-project5: This is a personal project designed to manage and track my job applications efficiently. The application allows me to register job offers, update their status and organize all relevant information in one place.
projects.info-project6: TV Box application developed in Flutter for a digital scoreboard. Compatible with Arduino, sensors, and other devices to automatically record throws. It allows you to keep score in real time, manage games with multiple players, and announce the winner. It includes narration of each score with audio effects, providing an interactive, modern, and entertaining experience.
